purpose: reproducible, non-cherry-picked record of every prior-art search executed for the Phase-23 novelty audit
search_date_note: single working session; WebSearch provider index + direct arXiv/CVF/Springer/ACM fetches
time_range: 2015-present (with foundational antecedents dated to 1970/1991/2001 where directly relevant)
databases_and_indices_screened: Google Scholar / general web index via search provider
Google Patents / Justia / USPTO Gazette (limited scan)
databases_not_directly_reachable: Semantic Scholar API (no key in session)
bioRxiv / medRxiv full text (not directly queried; indexed records only)

search_families.label: multi-domain / universal medical segmentation
search_families.notes: Shared multi-domain/universal medical segmentor is fully occupied (UniverSeg, MedSAM, SAM-Med2D, MedUniSeg, M4oE).

search_families.label: regional / coarse-to-fine refinement
search_families.notes: Always-execute cascades and regional refinement are occupied (nnU-Net cascade, Med-DANet, SegRefiner); the gate layer is the residual gap.

search_families.label: uncertainty-guided refinement
search_families.notes: Uncertainty-guided refinement is occupied and overwhelmingly driven by CURRENT uncertainty, not future-action benefit.

search_families.label: quality / error prediction
queries: segmentation quality prediction without ground truth
predict segmentation Dice without ground truth
search_families.notes: GT-free quality/error prediction is occupied; targets CURRENT or POST-REFINEMENT quality, not the ΔQ of a future action.

search_families.label: counterfactual benefit / value-of-computation
queries: predict expected improvement of computation adaptive inference
search_families.notes: HIGHEST-RISK family. Formal 'value of computation' (Russell & Wefald 1991), adaptive-inference bounds (Hor 2024), cascades with learned pass-on criteria (Latotzke 2021) and CATE meta-learners (Kunzel 2019) all occupy the mechanism at the general level.

search_families.label: conditional computation
search_families.notes: Conditional/adaptive compute is a mature field (ACT, SkipNet, MoD, ACM). Gating is common; a regression on paired GT-derived ΔQ for a segmentation refinement is not.

search_families.label: mixture-of-experts / routing
search_families.notes: Multi-domain gated medical segmentation is occupied (M4oE); pixel-wise predict-then-defer exists (DeferredSeg). Routing picks a PATHWAY/expert, not whether to spend on an optional refinement.

search_families.label: performance-preserving / safe routing
search_families.notes: Abstention/conformal/risk-control tools exist but operate on CURRENT confidence or POST-HOC output selection; none bounds the gain of a not-yet-executed refinement.

search_families.label: resource-aware / device-aware
search_families.notes: Lightweight/mobile/edge segmentation is a crowded generic area (MobileSAM, edge-adaptive nets). On its own it is engineering value, not algorithmic novelty.

search_families.label: tiny-object / small-lesion
search_families.notes: Tiny-lesion focus and regional zoom/super-resolution for small structures are already surveyed; the novelty cannot rest on the tiny-object problem or the zoom primitive.

search_families.label: falsification-first (deliberately aimed at disproving novelty)
queries: selective refinement based on expected gain
search_families.notes: The single most damaging find is JFS (Moon et al., ICIP 2025), which shares the SAME problem framing ('shall I keep the refined mask?') and a paired Δ target, but decides POST-HOC (after refinement) and has no cost term. It is the closest functional analogue in segmentation.

search_families.label: general-CV / ML precedence (concept origins outside medicine)
queries: Faster R-CNN region proposal network objectness
search_families.notes: Establishes that the mechanism is a general idea with 1970s-2000s antecedents (Chow reject rule 1970, Viola-Jones cascade 2001, RPN 2015). Limits any 'algorithm-level' novelty claim.

search_families.label: patent / prior-art scan (light, non-legal)
search_families.notes: Only general medical-segmentation documents surfaced; none identified in this limited search that claims 'predict-benefit-before-refining an optional expensive segmentation stage with a resource-cost-aware gate'. NOT a legal conclusion; a professional FTO search is required before any patentability statement.

verification_policy: Every retained paper was verified against at least one primary or authoritative index record (arXiv abstract page, CVF Open Access page, Springer/ACM/IEEE record). Items that could not be verified to the record level are marked UNVERIFIED and are excluded from the authoritative prior-art matrix (see phase23_excluded_nearby_works.csv).
cherry_picking_control: Two search families (K and L) were purpose-built to falsify the novelty claim and were run after the affirmative families, so any close equivalent would be surfaced rather than hidden.
totals_correction_note: totals.queries_logged was 55 while the per-family ledger and phase23_search_query_summary.csv both sum to 63; corrected to 63 so the ledger identity holds. No classification, verdict, retained or excluded paper is affected.
